name: DailyProfit
summary: This EA is a simple utility that calculates and prints the total realized profit from closed deals for the current trading day. It runs once at initialization and does not open, manage, or close any trades on its own.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个简单的工具，用于计算并打印当日已平仓交易的实现利润总额。它在初始化时运行一次，不会自行开仓、管理或平仓任何交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个日常利润统计工具。其核心逻辑是在OnInit初始化阶段调用DayProfit函数，获取当前服务器时间的日期字符串，再将该日期转换为当日起始时间戳，通过HistorySelect选定当日历史记录区间。随后遍历所有历史成交单，筛选出场类型为DEAL_ENTRY_OUT的平仓记录，累加每笔平仓的DEAL_PROFIT得到当日总利润。仓位管理方面完全不存在，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。资金管理方面同样不涉及，仅是读取历史数据进行汇总计算。策略概念上属于信息查询类工具，帮助交易者快速了解当日盈亏状况。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but rather a daily profit statistics utility. Its core logic calls the DayProfit function during OnInit initialization, obtains the current server time's date string, and converts it to the day's starting timestamp, then selects the historical record interval for the day via HistorySelect. It then iterates through all historical deals, filtering for closing records with DEAL_ENTRY_OUT entry type, and accumulates each deal's DEAL_PROFIT to obtain the total daily profit. There is no position management whatsoever since this EA does not execute any trading operations. Money management is likewise not involved; it only reads historical data for aggregation calculations. The strategy concept falls under information query tools, helping traders quickly understand their daily profit and loss status.

parameters.name: 无外部参数
parameters.description: 该EA没有任何可配置的外部输入参数
parameters.description_en: This EA has no configurable external input parameters

pros: 代码简洁明了，逻辑直观易懂
仅读取历史数据，不对账户产生任何交易风险
利用HistorySelect精确限定时间范围，避免统计非当日数据
pros_en: Code is concise and straightforward with intuitive logic
Only reads historical data, posing zero trading risk to the account
Uses HistorySelect to precisely define the time range, avoiding counting non-current-day data
cons: 仅在OnInit中运行一次，不会实时更新当日利润
没有考虑佣金、掉期和手续费等交易成本，利润统计不完整
缺少输入参数，无法自定义统计日期范围或筛选交易品种
没有图形界面展示结果，仅靠Print输出到日志，使用不便
cons_en: Runs only once during OnInit, does not update daily profit in real-time
Does not account for commissions, swaps, and fees, making profit calculation incomplete
Lacks input parameters, preventing customization of date range or symbol filtering
No GUI display; relies solely on Print output to logs, which is inconvenient to use
improvements: 添加OnTimer定时调用DayProfit实现实时利润监控
将佣金(DEAL_COMMISSION)、掉期(DEAL_SWAP)和手续费纳入利润计算，使统计更准确
improvements_en: Add OnTimer periodic calls to DayProfit for real-time profit monitoring
Include commission (DEAL_COMMISSION), swap (DEAL_SWAP), and fee in profit calculation for more accurate statistics

risk_points: 该EA为纯只读工具，不执行任何交易操作，无交易风险
仅依赖Print输出，无信息泄露或误操作风险
risk_points_en: This EA is a pure read-only tool with no trading operations and zero trading risk
Only relies on Print output, with no risk of information leakage or accidental operations

summary_en: This EA is a simple utility that calculates and prints the total realized profit from closed deals for the current trading day. It runs once at initialization and does not open, manage, or close any trades on its own.
